sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין פּוֹחֲתִין מִשִּׁשָּׁה טְלָאִים הַמְבוּקָּרִין בְּלִשְׁכַּת הַטְּלָאִים, כְּדֵי לַשַּׁבָּת וּלְיָמִים טוֹבִים שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, וּמוֹסִיפִין עַד עוֹלָם. אֵין פּוֹחֲתִין מִשְּׁתֵּי חֲצוֹצְרוֹת, מִתִּשְׁעָה כִּנּוֹרוֹת, וּמוֹסִיפִין עַד עוֹלָם, וְהַצִּלְצָל לְבַד.

positions.claim: no fewer than six inspected lambs are kept in the Chamber of the Lambs, enough for Shabbat and the two Festival days of Rosh HaShana, and more may be added without limit
positions.basis: the needs of the communal offerings of Shabbat and the adjacent Festival days

positions.claim: no fewer than two trumpets and nine harps are played, and more may be added without limit, but the cymbal is played alone
